checks.evidence: You may withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal applies to future processing based on that consent
it does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal
or override separate legal obligations to retain your data

ratings.reason: Preserves prospective withdrawal and separate retention duties. Unchanged prior lawfulness preserves valid-consent processing without asserting that all prior processing was lawful.

checks.evidence: You may withdraw consent at any time for future processing.
Withdrawal does not make processing already carried out under valid consent unlawful.
It also does not cancel separate legal duties to retain data.

ratings.reason: Clearly preserves the timing, valid-consent qualification, and continuing legal retention duties. No material omissions.

cases.preference_reason: Both accurately clarify the legal effects of withdrawal; the different formulations preserve the same decision-relevant meaning.
